title: Habitat Helper
intro: Find each living thing's home, then see what the home gives it.
note: This is a model. Visit a real place near school and count the living things you find.
summary: A habitat gives a living thing food, water, shelter and space. Different habitats, like a pond, a forest and a sand dune, have different living things because they give different things.

stages.prompt: Where does each living thing live in Michigan?

cards.label: Green frog
cards.why: A frog lives in and near water, where it finds insects and cool, wet places.
cards.hint: it needs lots of water close by.

cards.label: Beaver
cards.why: A beaver lives in the water and uses sticks to build a lodge.
cards.hint: it builds a home in water with sticks.

cards.label: Cattail plant
cards.why: Cattails grow with their roots in wet mud at the edge of a pond.
cards.hint: its roots like to stay very wet.

cards.label: White-tailed deer
cards.why: A forest gives deer leaves to eat and trees to hide among.
cards.hint: it eats leaves and hides among trees.

cards.label: Squirrel
cards.why: Squirrels eat acorns and live in tall trees.
cards.hint: it eats acorns and climbs tall trees.

cards.label: Piping plover
cards.why: Piping plovers nest on open sandy beaches near the dunes.
cards.hint: it nests on open, sandy ground.

cards.label: Dune grass
cards.why: Dune grass has long roots that grow in sand and hold the dune in place.
cards.hint: its long roots grow in sand.

stages.prompt: What does each thing give a living thing? Pick the need it meets.

cards.label: Acorns under an oak
cards.why: Acorns are food for squirrels and deer.

cards.label: Berries on a bush
cards.why: Berries are food for birds and other animals.

cards.label: A clean stream
cards.why: A stream gives animals water to drink.

cards.label: A pond edge to drink from
cards.why: Animals drink at the pond edge.

cards.label: A hollow log
cards.why: A hollow log gives animals a safe place to hide or sleep.
cards.hint: is it a safe place to hide?

cards.label: A thick bush
cards.why: A thick bush gives animals shelter from wind and from other animals.
cards.hint: is it a safe place to hide?

cards.label: A wide open meadow
cards.why: A big open place gives animals room to move and find what they need.
cards.hint: is it about having room to move?

cards.label: Room between the trees to run
cards.why: Room to run and move is space.
cards.hint: is it about having room to move?
